HUGE List Of NXT Names Earmarked For Main Roster Call-Ups (WWE News)

At least 8 new faces set to hit Raw and SmackDown in mass WWE NXT shake up.

by Jamie Kennedy
Nov 27, 2026 November 27th, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:35
Instaread

Dave Meltzer claimed via Wrestling Observer Radio that every NXT star involved in the upcoming John Cena Classic on 14 December in Orlando, Florida is "earmarked" to join WWE's main roster.

That means no less than 8 names (of those announced to date) will be moving from the developmental brand to either Raw or SmackDown: Zilla Fatu, Kelani Jordan, Izzi Dame, Shiloh Hill, Kendal Grey, Wren Sinclair, Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno will all find new homes.

Of those, only Dar has experienced any meaningful run on the main roster. He joined WWE way back in 2016, which is something Noam asked Cena to keep quiet during a backstage segment announcing his involvement in the JCC project.

The next question is this: Will Dar and Moreno work as a tag-team on Raw or SmackDown? Triple H hasn't exactly been keen to push the tag divisions across both major shows. In fact, the general consensus within WWE is that fans don't really care about doubles action the way they used to.

Zilla Fatu, Kelani Jordan and Izzi Dame are arguably the highest profile of the call-ups. Jordan and Dame have been making a sizeable splash in NXT for a while now, but Fatu only joined the promotion in August. It's looking like a quick turnaround under Shawn Michaels for him.

WWE will run concurrent episodes of Monday Night Raw on 14 December - one in Orlando for the Classic, and another over in Perth, Australia.

Lifelong wrestling, video game, music and sports obsessive who has been writing about his passions since childhood. Jamie started writing for WhatCulture in 2013, and has contributed thousands of articles and YouTube videos since then. He cut his teeth penning published pieces for top UK and European wrestling read Fighting Spirit Magazine (FSM), and also has extensive experience working within the wrestling biz as a manager and commentator for promotions like ICW on WWE Network and WCPW/Defiant since 2010.
